name: metamodel.mermaid
title: Show metamodel as Mermaid
summary: The graph of the metamodel written as a Mermaid flowchart: each type with its prefix and properties, each inheritance, relation kind and relation property as an edge.
details: The same types and links as the app's graph of the metamodel, as text: one node per type with its name, prefix and properties, the inherited ones marked, the node "Any type" only when a relation kind or property leaves a side open, and one edge per ordered pair of nodes with one label line per link. While the metamodel is missing or faulty it writes what `metamodel.get` gives. The CLI prints the text alone.

mermaid.description: The Mermaid flowchart, bottom to top, LF line endings and a final newline, escaped as in `trace.mermaid`.

problems.description: The problems of the metamodel, as `metamodel.get` gives them.
